name: RadioPul'sar
source:
One day, a simple Japanese hikkikomori named Kenji has to go outside. The reason for going out is quite ordinary - he has to take out the trash. But the trash isn't exactly ordinary. And even more unusual meeting awaits him at the garbage collection site. So much so that Kenji won't get home until after dark! And that's just the beginning of a strange story...


[From [url=https://anivisual.net/board/2-1-0-1235]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
有一天，一位名叫Kenji的普通日本蛰居族必须外出。出门的原因很平常——他要去倒垃圾。但这些垃圾并不普通。而更不寻常的会面在垃圾收集站等待着他。以至于Kenji直到天黑才回家！而这只是一个奇怪故事的开始……


[来自[url=https://anivisual.net/board/2-1-0-1235]Anivis[/url]]
